whenToUse: Consumables discounted from two or three units.
The unit price changes with quantity.
You show the total before adding to the cart.
whenNotToUse: The unit price is the same regardless of bundling (use a quantity stepper).
You'd push people to add quantities they don't want.

alternatives.name: Number Stepper
alternatives.reason: Choosing a quantity without a discount.

alternatives.name: Free Shipping Progress
alternatives.reason: When the order amount, not quantity, is the threshold.

accessibility: The minus and plus buttons have names and become disabled at their limits.
The total is read via aria-live whenever it changes.
Whether the discount applies is stated in words, not color.
